pair_distance_metric: XY horizontal Euclidean distance; ignores z
height_reference: 地图最低点=0 m，地形范围0～365.84 m

start.scope: Unity triangle mesh model; not real-world survey

landing.scope: Unity triangle mesh model; not real-world survey

end.scope: Unity triangle mesh model; not real-world survey

end2.scope: Unity triangle mesh model; not real-world survey

final_endpoints: 各组到达自身终点时离地2米，随后在原位置垂直下降着陆

warnings: 通往终点 1 的直线接近建筑 ProxyBuilding_0002；保留直线，交由后续局部避障处理。
plan.terminal_terrain_reference: terrain check only; does not change the straight XY route
plan.synchronization: 巡航按同步路线进度；末段按各组路径进度由离地5m递减至2m，到终点后着陆。
plan.method: 选点间直线；巡航净空内的地形或建筑障碍触发绕行，绕行折点间保持直线
plan.limits: 几何规划预览。平台未配置；地面、建筑及局部避障结果仅提示，尚未完成执行前验证。

note: 直线几何规划预览；平台未配置，地面检查仅提示。XY直线上为表达地形跟随高度而采样的中间点不代表横向绕行。未下发飞行。

point_pick.load_policy: point.json on every page load and recommendation reload
point_pick.route_policy: read plan routes from point.json; editing points creates a browser draft
point_pick.landing_semantics: 公共低空到达／下降完成点，离地5m；两个终点离地2m后着陆

assembly_region.scope: User-authorized expanded low-altitude assembly region; original start, endpoints and landing center preserved. Sampled geometry requires runtime sensor and trajectory validation.
